verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a web-crawling library/service, not an agent that consumes external tools; the evidence shows it exposes an official MCP *server* (crawl4ai-probe-3) so that agents like Cursor/Claude can plug into it, which is the reverse relationship from the story's 'plug MCP servers into this product' framing. There is no evidence of Crawl4AI acting as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools, and this role doesn't fit its product category.
